cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the central bank's notice covers banks.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): Banco de Moçambique's Notice 4/GGBM/2003 binds banks' data centres, not state data (MOZ-001). INTIC's draft cloud regulation, out for consultation in 2025 (MOZ-003), is a draft rule, so stage 2.
